subject: Temporary sandbox fuel for EdgeScale peak probe
messages:
From: Daniel Park <daniel@edgescale.com>
To: Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 25 Jun 2028 16:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: extra sandbox fuel for overnight peak probe

Hi Camila,

Thanks again for the call earlier — EdgeScale's platform team (SRE) wants to run a focused overnight soak on July 1 to validate end-to-end latency at sustained 6k TPS for 6 hours. This is a narrower validation than our previous POC but requires a temporary spike in non-prod quota and token credits to reliably reproduce tail behaviour.

Plan snapshot attached (poc-load-plan.pdf) — it lists traffic shape, ramp, expected KV-cache hit assumptions, and SLOs we will measure. Key asks: a 48h sandbox uplift beginning 2028-06-30 22:00 PT, and an ephemeral token allocation large enough to cover an estimated 8M tokens during the soak.

We can provide a short mutual action plan and coordinate test windows with your SRE on-call. Procurement looped here for any paperwork.

Appreciate quick confirmation so we can lock the test slot.

—Daniel
Daniel Park
Head of Platform Eng, EdgeScale
daniel@edgescale.com

Attachment: poc-load-plan.pdf (application/pdf, 312 KB)
From: Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.ai>
To: Daniel Park <daniel@edgescale.com>
Cc: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 26 Jun 2028 09:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: extra sandbox fuel for overnight peak probe

Hi Daniel — thanks for the detailed plan. I reviewed the PDF and the load profile looks well scoped. Quick notes:

- Confirming the window 2028-06-30 22:00 PT -> 2028-07-01 04:00 PT (48h uplift start time will cover preflight & postflight checks).
- You requested ~8M tokens; please confirm whether those are prompt+completion tokens or completion only.

Markus / Priyom — looping you both for approval on a temporary sandbox credit uplift and any billing/promotional constraints. If we can approve a short-term voucher (48–72h) with a hard cap and a rollback to baseline immediately after the window, I can communicate the go-ahead to EdgeScale and publish the canary route for the soak.

Daniel — can you also share a short list of the alert thresholds you want watched so we can add tracing hooks and alert on qps/latency regressions?

Thanks,
Camila Reyes
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
camila_reyes@redwood.ai
From: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>
To: Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 27 Jun 2028 11:16:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: extra sandbox fuel for overnight peak probe

Camila — thanks for the heads-up. Approving a timeboxed sandbox uplift under the following constraints:

- Voucher validity: 48 hours starting 2028-06-30 22:00 PT
- Token cap: 9,000,000 (prompt + completion) — a small buffer over EdgeScale's estimate
- Route policy: routed to non-prod pool with cpu/gpu throttling disabled for this test only
- Observability: on-call must subscribe to INF-782 and we will enable additional tracing for the period

Priyom, please ensure billing tags and promo config are set and that the voucher is non-renewing. Lauren, can you liaise with Support to add the extra tracing hooks and forward any post-test logs to EdgeScale for their verification?

If everyone is aligned, Camila can send the go-ahead to EdgeScale and attach the voucher code.

—Markus
Markus Klein
Head of Sales Engineering, Redwood Inference
markus_klein@redwood.ai
From: Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.ai>
To: Daniel Park <daniel@edgescale.com>
Cc: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>, EdgeScale Procurement <procurement@edgescale.com>, SRE Team <sre@edgescale.com>
Date: Fri, 30 Jun 2028 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Approved: temporary sandbox uplift & voucher (EdgeScale POC)

Hi Daniel — good news: we approved the temporary uplift and issued a one-time voucher. Details below and attached:

Voucher: REDWOOD-ES-48H-9M
Validity: 2028-06-30 22:00 PT -> 2028-07-02 22:00 PT (48h active window, auto-revoke after expiry)
Token cap: 9,000,000 (prompt + completion)
Route: non-prod isolated pool; tracing enabled and INF-782 subscribed

Attachments: poc-load-plan.pdf, slo-metrics.csv (stubbed attachments)
Related links: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/ES-POC-4291, https://drive.google.com/file/d/1a2b3cPOCLoadPlan

Next steps:
1) Please confirm you received the voucher and that the SRE team will start a preflight check at 2028-06-30 20:00 PT.
2) Priyom will post the voucher and billing tags; Markus will be on-call for product questions during the soak.
3) After the run, please share the post-test metrics (tail latency, p95/p99, error rates) and we will review together — Redwood will keep logs for 14 days per the test agreement.

If procurement needs an official promo addendum, procurement@edgescale.com — loop me and I’ll route to Finance.

Best,
Camila Reyes
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
camila_reyes@redwood.ai

Attachments: poc-load-plan.pdf (application/pdf), slo-metrics.csv (text/csv)
